lead.event: OJK sets a 120% minimum solvency ratio for insurers
lead.headline: OJK sets insurers’ minimum solvency ratio at 120%
lead.blurb: OJK issued the regulation on 26 October, requiring insurers designated as Domestic Significantly Important Insurers to hold additional capital equal to 15% of risk-based minimum capital (MMBR). It also sets rules for capital classification and risk calculations, and requires annual stress tests and audited solvency reports. The new calculation applies from first-quarter 2027 reports, while sanctions for breaches begin with first-quarter 2028 reporting.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK sanctions 10 capital market violation cases and orders illicit gains returned
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK sanctions 10 cases and orders Rp23.77 billion returned
market_structure_policy.blurb: Semen Indonesia was fined Rp550 million and must transfer at least 236.74 million SMCB shares to the public by 31 December 2026. The cases also included manipulation involving HOMI, SAMF and SMDM, and OJK imposed Rp3.71 billion in total administrative fines.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: SMGR was fined Rp550 million and must transfer at least 236,738,922 SMCB shares to the public by 31 December 2026.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI consults on Indonesia’s possible reclassification to standalone market
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI consults on Indonesia’s possible standalone reclassification as reforms cover owners above 1%
market_structure_policy.blurb: MSCI has opened a consultation on moving Indonesia from emerging to standalone market. Reforms also include more granular investor classification, oversight of concentrated shareholdings and transaction supervision. Manulife Aset Manajemen Indonesia portfolio manager Rizki Ardhi says regulators should provide MSCI with verifiable evidence of improvements.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Rakyat Indonesia reports Q3 savings balance and net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI reports Rp634.8tn savings and Rp48.2tn Q3 net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI's savings balance topped BCA's Rp628.4 trillion, reversing a Rp45.9 trillion gap in March 2025. Net profit rose 16.8% year on year, making BRI Indonesia's most profitable bank.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Rakyat Indonesia targets 20% ROE by 2028
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI targets around 20% ROE by 2028
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI plans to revive Kupedes micro lending, optimize capital and sustain dividends, with a short-term ROE target of 17%-18%. Management considers a payout ratio of around 60% sustainable and targets a stable dividend per share for fiscal 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Merdeka Gold Resources reports nine-month loss amid Pani mine production ramp-up
earnings_guidance.headline: EMAS reports Rp339.6 billion nine-month loss as Pani ramps up production
earnings_guidance.blurb: Its 2027 production outlook is 165,000-180,000 ounces. Pani produced 26,331 ounces in Q3, up 69% quarter on quarter, while nine-month output reached 43,743 ounces; Merdeka Gold Resources attributed the loss to timing differences between production and sales recognition and tax expenses.
